message.content: Tesherv’aals’ trolleybuses sailed down Lucid Avenue, their groaning electrical bodies kissing power lines overhead in the deepening purple twilight, though the diligent little geckoes clinging to grimy workshop vents merely observed humans rushing home with unsettlingly still eyes; as dusk painted the glass buttresses of the Sky-Bazaar with molten gold, the geckoes descended the weathered stone walls like tiny green downspouts drawn to the pools of warmth radiating fromExacta-brand trolleybus stops, their sticky pads finding purchase on the humming, vibration-scarred metal even as the hissed departures startled other insects, until the great cable-car yawned awake for its shift above the city, carrying not humans observably, but entire thriving colonies of geckoes racing towards the Observatory domes, where they’d feast on attracted moths under the captive electric moons bolted to the trolleybus termini. Their rhythmic clicks after dark were the city’s counterpoint to the constants groan, echoing like scattered trolley tokens on the cobbles, leaving dewy green jests clinging to rain-slicked walls long after weary conductors secured the turquoise surge-guns humming inside the bays.
